description:
List persisted campaign simulation runs.

Luca operation: GET /api/campaigns/{id}/simulations
Required scopes: campaigns:read
Required OAuth scope: luca:read; data sensitivity: redacted
Does not require idempotency.
Use workspaceId or workspaceSlug to override the default workspace configured by environment.

maxPages.description: Max pages the server auto-fetches and merges (default 10, hard cap 50). If more remain, the result is marked truncated with a nextCursor to continue.

name: luca_campaigns_simulations_list
title: List a campaign's simulations
